Bash(br create --title "Set up project structure and dependencies" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Description
Initialize the krankie project with proper structure, TypeScript config, and dependencies.

## Tasks
- Create src/ directory structure as per design doc
- Set up package.json with dependencies:
  - `ink` and `react` for TUI
  - CLI argument parsing \(consider using Bun''s built-in or minimal lib\)
- Configure tsconfig.json for Bun
- Create bin entry point

## Acceptance Criteria
- `bun run src/cli/index.ts --help` shows usage
- Project structure matches design doc
EOF
\)" --label setup)
